title: fix(security): pin container grpc and bd Thrift versions
body:
Summary:
- raise the rebuilt gh and Dolt grpc floor to 1.83.2
- force rebuilt bd to grpc 1.83.2 and Thrift 0.24.0, with embedded-module assertions
- remove only the obsolete grpc waivers and bd Thrift waiver path
- add the immutable release-gate record for ga-kkktn4

Review:
- ga-htipw0: PASS on exact source 96b3ec3f450ed1883e27570244fb14a096541af0
- scope preserves the outside-contributor fixes from PR #6389 and leaves kubectl/Dolt Thrift follow-up out of this round

Test plan:
- full local 40-job union: 38 jobs passed, 2 raw external bd schema-bootstrap failures attributed to pre-existing ga-e2z1zb; all 8 diff-owned executions passed
- fresh base, agent, and controller images built successfully
- extracted bd embeds grpc v1.83.2 and Thrift v0.24.0
- pinned Trivy 0.70.0: zero HIGH/CRITICAL findings in all three images and zero config misconfigurations
- vet, build, candidate lint/format, policy, docs, boundary, dependency, event-isolation, and DoltLite checks passed; pre-push fast suite 10/10 passed

Refs ga-kkktn4, ga-rl1l10, ga-htipw0.
